title: Constructibility from generic finite local constancy on closed subschemes
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $\Lambda$ a commutative ring, and $F$ a sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Assume that for every closed immersion $i:Z\to X$ [def-weil-closed-immersion] with $Z$ Noetherian, there is a dense open $U\subseteq Z$ on which $i^*F$ [prop-constructible-pullback] is finite locally constant [def-constructible-finite-locally-constant]. Then $F$ is constructible [def-constructible-constructible]. No target sheaf or monomorphism is assumed, and no Noetherian condition on $\Lambda$ is needed.

source.place: Tag 09BH, Proposition 59.74.1 (3), proof of (3), Noetherian-induction step; Tag 095E, finite stratifications

proof.text: Induct on closed subsets C of X, with the strengthened claim for every closed immersion i:Z -> X whose range is contained in C. Closed subsets satisfy the well-founded descending condition. Z is Noetherian since it is a closed subscheme of X; in Lean use LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian and QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace, both applied to i, then construct IsNoetherian Z.

For empty Z its sheaf is zero and therefore constructible. Otherwise choose the dense open U supplied by the hypothesis; it is nonempty. The reduced closed complement i′:Z′ -> Z has range Z minus U. Its image C′ in X is a proper closed subset of C: a point of U maps to C but cannot lie in that image because i is injective. Apply the induction hypothesis to i′ composed with i.

Pullback composition transports the constructibility just obtained to the restriction of i^*F to Z′. On U the finite locally constant sheaf is constructible by the trivial one-stratum stratification and pullback stability. Apply the existing open-closed constructibility equivalence to glue these two restrictions. Finally take C=X and i=id, and use the identity pullback isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem constructible_of_closed_generic
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] {Λ : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing Λ]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (h : ∀ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (i : Z ⟶ X), IsClosedImmersion i → IsNoetherian Z →
      ∃ U : Z.Opens, Dense (U : Set Z) ∧
        IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) U.ι).obj
          ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) i).obj F))) :
    IsConstructibleSheaf F
